content:
**Highway 35** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

Highway 35 runs south to north, starting at the Ohio-West Virginia state line, just west of the Silver Bridge in Point Pleasant. The road then runs in serpentines up the hill, passing a checkpoint with dead Cultists and a sabotaged Abraxodyne Chemical truck that attracted some Feral Ghouls, until it reaches and passes through Checkpoint Canyon.

On the other side, it runs north for a short distance, passing the Welcome to Ohio Sign, before turning west, temporarily merging with Route 7. Further west, it then turns into an elevated, mostly destroyed highway, with the only part still intact being Highway Town in the center. It then ends due west of Highway Town, in front of a collapsed pass.
